rounds.q: How many minutes does sunlight take to reach Earth?
rounds.why: Voyager 1 reaches one light-day from Earth on Nov. 18, 2026, about 26 billion km out.
rounds.src: NASA Science, Voyager 1: What Is a Light-Day
rounds.fun: The sunlight on your face left the Sun about 8 minutes ago. Fresh delivery! ☀️

rounds.q: How many confirmed moons does Saturn have?
rounds.why: In March 2025 alone, astronomers added 128 new Saturn moons in one batch.
rounds.fun: 293 moons, and 128 showed up in one batch. Saturn just keeps collecting! 🪐

rounds.q: How hot is the surface of Venus, in degrees Fahrenheit?
rounds.why: Venus is hotter than Mercury, even though Mercury is closer to the Sun.
rounds.fun: 872°F, and hotter than Mercury too. Venus does not need a heater! 🔥

rounds.q: How many Earth days does Venus take to spin around once?
rounds.why: A Venus year is only 225 Earth days, so its day is longer than its year.
rounds.fun: A Venus day is longer than its year. You'd have a birthday before bedtime! 🎂

rounds.q: How many working satellites are orbiting Earth right now?
rounds.why: Trackers follow about 47,000 objects in orbit. Most aren't working satellites.
rounds.fun: About 15,900 working satellites among 47,000 tracked objects. Busy skies up there! 🛰️
